sentence: This project studies how to tell how aggressive an early-stage lung adenocarcinoma is before surgery, using chest CT and a small biopsy.
This project builds an AI-based model that uses CT scan features and clinical data to predict death risk in people hospitalized with alcoholic hepatitis.
This project builds zebrafish models of tic disorders to test what genetic mutations linked to the disorders do.
This project studies how cells detect and repair common DNA damage, especially single strand breaks and damaged bases.
This project studies the role of one protein in neuroblastoma and the epigenetic and transcriptional effects of losing it.
This project supports basic science research on dietary supplements made from plants and on complementary and integrative medicine.
This project builds tools to study how genetic factors interact with each other and with aging in Alzheimer's disease, using stem cell models.
This project studies how ligand gated ion channels, which are proteins, work and how they help cells respond to chemical cues.
This project builds and tests a genomic medicine eConsult service that brings genomic testing into routine clinical care.
This project builds imaging tools for studying biology across many scales.
This project tests targeted, topical therapies for precancerous lesions, using preclinical models of anal cancer in people living with HIV.
This project builds an image-guided robotic method to repair a dislocated ankle syndesmosis using automatic 3D planning and imaging during surgery.
This project builds a computational imaging method for free-breathing dynamic MRI to evaluate the heart and lung.
This project studies how an abnormal number of sex chromosomes changes clinical outcomes and tests whether sex chromosome gene expression predicts severity.
This project tests drugs and drug combinations in patient-derived xenograft models of breast cancer to match treatments to tumor features.
This project builds mutant versions of a tick-borne bacterium whose gene function can be restored, and tests effects on mouse infection and tick transmission.
This project builds deep learning tools that check radiation therapy treatment plans for accuracy and reliability.
This project builds a systematic way to interpret noncoding variants and how they link genetics to gene expression and disease.
This project studies how individual, social and structural risk factors affect drug overdose among people living with HIV.
